messages.subject: For Åsa Jackson | Sustainability, stakeholder relations and responsible mining
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Nilsson,

Please place this executive introduction before Ms. Åsa Jackson, Executive Vice President, People and Sustainability.

Boliden's mining and smelting activities place sustainability, stakeholder confidence and disciplined external engagement close to long-term operating performance. My current mandate sits at that same intersection, connecting government, communities, ESG commitments and operating teams inside a large mining environment.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead institutional engagement, coordinate multi-agency and community matters, and translate external commitments into clear internal owners, evidence requirements and executive escalation. I also support stakeholder governance around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage, and I coordinated a carbon-accounting evidence pilot using operating records.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this experience might support Boliden's sustainability, stakeholder-relations, social-performance or external-affairs priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Boliden.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
